scope: Lifecycle code only; no mathematical/model/config changes; no formal training or held-out testing

tests.scope: Synthetic lifecycle tests only: mocked receivers and temporary cases; no formal training or held-out experiment

remaining_limits: Pause is observed at receiver scene boundaries; an in-progress original inference finishes before the next boundary.
Completed validation batches may be recomputed after interruption; training cursor/optimizer is checkpointed so completed optimizer steps are not repeated.
An orphan scene without receipt is accepted only after exact deterministic regeneration; a changed recorded scene is rejected.
Timing resumes require the same device type, GPU model (CUDA), platform/processor and PyTorch version; result files are not silently mixed across runtimes.
